title: Making an international standard cup of tea
summary: Tom Scott follows the ISO 3103 / BS 6008 standard to make an international standard cup of tea, using specialist tasting equipment. The video shows how precisely the standard is specified.
why: Used to illustrate that the standard targets consistency rather than taste, and to discuss what standardization is for.

quote.text: TL;DR is that the standard is used for the most consistent tea, not most tasty/enjoyable tea
